message: In the concealed twin Tuned Mass Damper (TMD, mass on spring with damper tuned to bridge mode) support concept, the deck-view preservation method has visibility risk raised by Manager, thank you Manager. To check it I used the concealed mounting detail sketch (E9) with the under-deck twin-unit layout sketch (E7). I found zero hardware above deck level with 150 millimetre clearance below the soffit, according to Setra, 2006. I propose retaining below-soffit clamp beams with deck-matching paint and removable covers, thank you Structural Dynamics Lead. My position: ready because deck-view preservation is shown. In the same concealed support concept, the under-deck connection method has static load-path uncertainty, thank you Vibration Control Specialist. To check it I used the slip factor calculation (E15) with the unit weight calculation (E10) and the clamp-beam stress check (E14). I found 14.68 slip factor with 36 kilonewtons friction versus 2452.5 newtons weight, according to Coulomb, 1785. I propose four Metric 20 (M20, 20 millimetre diameter bolts) U-bolts per Square Hollow Section (SHS, square steel tube) beam, thank you Pedestrian Comfort and Construction Planner. My position: ready because under-deck geometry and connection fidelity are quantified.
